Prekidač HTTPS slušatelja i odabir Secreta
Prekidač „Prikaži put do Podova” (EndpointSlice → Pod IP)
Gumbi za kvar: „Obriši pravilo za /api”, „Krivi Secret za certifikat”, „Krivi naziv Servicea”
flagshipSimulation.model: Listener hostname match first (exact beats wildcard); among matching rules precedence simplified per Gateway API spec: Exact path > longest PathPrefix > more header matches; no match → 404. Weights: each request picks a backend Service with probability weight/Σweights (per request, L7). Within a backend the Gateway reads the Service's EndpointSlices (ready endpoints only) and picks a Pod per request (sim: least request, labelled 'ovisi o implementaciji'); ClusterIP/kube-proxy is not on this path. backendRef to a missing Service → route condition ResolvedRefs=False and matching requests get HTTP 500 (Gateway API spec). HTTPS: TLS terminated at the Gateway via certificateRefs to a kubernetes.io/tls Secret in the same namespace (cross-namespace needs ReferenceGrant); invalid Secret → listener not programmed, HTTPS handshakes fail. Ingress view shows spec.rules; weights shown as 'ovisi o kontroleru' annotations.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: Deleting the /api rule sends API calls to the web app (prefix / catches them); a wrong certificate Secret breaks HTTPS for everyone; a wrong Service name returns 500 with ResolvedRefs=False.
flagshipSimulation.insight: The same load-balancing idea from L04, split into layers and roles: the platform team owns the gate, each app team owns its routes; L7 routing, per-request balancing and weights live here, not in the Service.

misconceptions: „Ingress je vrsta Servicea” — a separate API that needs a controller.
„Ingress je zastario i uklonjen” — GA and frozen; Gateway API is recommended.
„Koristite ingress-nginx” — retired 2026-03-24: no releases or security fixes.
„Gateway API je ugrađen u svaki klaster” — CRDs + a controller must be installed.
„F5-ov NGINX Ingress Controller isto je što i ingress-nginx” — a different, still-maintained project.
„Promet kroz Gateway prolazi kroz ClusterIP” — most implementations send each request straight to Pod IPs from the EndpointSlices.
„Gateway zamjenjuje objekte Service” — routes still name Services (for endpoint discovery), and Services still serve in-cluster traffic.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] Ingress API is GA but frozen – not deprecated; the project recommends Gateway API.

[tech-facts] Gateway API is an add-on (CRDs + controller); core kinds GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute; v1.0 GA 2023-10-31; v1.6.0 (2026-06) moved TCPRoute/UDPRoute to Standard; current v1.6.2 (as of 2026-10).
[tech-facts] ingress-nginx retirement announced 2025-11-11, effective 2026-03-24 (no releases or security fixes); ingress2gateway 1.0 released 2026-03-20, current 1.2.0.
[tech-facts] Conformant implementations include Envoy Gateway, Istio, Cilium, NGINX Gateway Fabric, Traefik, Kong, GKE; Envoy-based gateways route to endpoints directly, bypassing kube-proxy.
[tech-facts] Invalid backendRef → ResolvedRefs=False and HTTP 500 for matching requests.
analogies: Gradska vrata: jedan ulaz, a prema natpisu (domena, putanja) šalju vas u pravu četvrt. Breaks down: the gate only routes, it doesn't run the shops, and different owners write different rules.
lectures.bridgeToNext: HTTPS radi, a certifikat živi u objektu Secret. Ali lozinka baze i ključ SMS-gatewaya i dalje stoje kao obične varijable okruženja u `deployment.yaml` – u Git repozitoriju koji je jedan dan bio javan.

scenes.visual: „Dekodiraj” button reveals the password instantly.

scenes.title: Gdje tajna živi
scenes.concept: In etcd, unencrypted by default (identity provider; base64 is only the API representation). Providers: identity (no encryption) → secretbox or aesgcm (local key in a file on the control-plane host) → KMS v2 (key in an external KMS, recommended); aescbc exists but is not recommended (CBC padding-oracle). Envelope DEK/KEK in DeepDive; managed clusters differ (EKS encrypts by default).
scenes.visual: etcd disk with plaintext; provider ladder; key file sitting next to etcd on the control-plane disk.

scenes.title: Tko može pročitati?
scenes.concept: get; list/watch also return contents; anyone who can create Pods/Deployments in the namespace can mount it; the built-in view ClusterRole reads Pods, Deployments and ConfigMaps but deliberately not Secrets – the real difference between ConfigMap and Secret; compromised Pod; Role/RoleBinding, ServiceAccount, least privilege, RBAC is additive.
scenes.visual: Attacker eyes red/grey.

scenes.title: Kada aplikacija vidi promjenu
scenes.concept: Env var: stale until container restart; volume: eventually (kubelet sync + cache), app must re-read; subPath: never; kubectl rollout restart.
scenes.visual: Side-by-side update timeline.

scenes.title: Pravila
scenes.concept: Never store Secret manifests in Git; never ENV/ARG in Dockerfile (BuildKit secret mounts for build time, L08); prefer mounted files (env vars leak into logs/dumps/child processes); DeepDive: Namespace is not a security boundary alone (NetworkPolicy, Pod Security Admission; PSP removed 1.25); teaser L23.

flagshipSimulation.name: Put tajne
flagshipSimulation.description: E5 threat model for the DB password: choose where it lives and how the Pod consumes it, toggle protections, see which attackers can read it (red eye = can read), then rotate it. Zadaci: „Zatvorite što više očiju”, „Objasnite zašto oko „smije stvarati Podove” ostaje crveno”, „Rotirajte lozinku bez ponovnog pokretanja Poda”.
controls: Segmented „Gdje je lozinka”: u slici (ENV) / env u deployment.yaml / ConfigMap / Secret
Prekidač „Šifriranje u mirovanju” s izborom pružatelja: lokalni ključ (secretbox/aesgcm) / KMS v2
Gumbi za kvar: „Ukradi kopiju baze etcd”, „Ukradi disk upravljačke ravnine”, „Spremi secret.yaml u Git”, „Ispiši env u log”
flagshipSimulation.model: Access graph. Git reader: reads iff the value (plain or base64) is in a committed file. Image puller: iff baked into the image. etcd-backup thief: iff stored in etcd (Pod spec env, ConfigMap or Secret) AND encryption at rest off. Control-plane disk thief: like the etcd thief, but also red with a local-key provider (key file on the same host); grey only with KMS v2. User with role view in the namespace (reads Pods, Deployments, ConfigMaps): red iff the value is an env literal in the Pod spec or in a ConfigMap; grey for a Secret. User with get or list on secrets/configmaps: iff value is in that kind; least-privilege toggle removes these verbs from the developer role. User who can create Pods/Deployments in the namespace: iff value is in a Secret/ConfigMap there (can mount it) – stays red regardless of get/list. Compromised app Pod: always red (honest limit). Log reader: iff consumed as env and 'Ispiši env u log' pressed. Rotation: env consumers keep the old value until restart; volume consumers see it after kubelet sync + cache delay (sim 10 s, labelled 'stvarno: s odgodom sinkronizacije kubeleta'), and only if the app re-reads; subPath never.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: „Ukradi kopiju baze etcd” reads every Secret until encryption at rest is on; „Ukradi disk upravljačke ravnine” still reads them with a local key; „Spremi secret.yaml u Git” exposes the password to every Git reader forever; rotation leaves env Pods stale and subPath mounts never update.
flagshipSimulation.insight: base64 is a costume, not a lock; protection is layered – RBAC, encryption at rest with a key stored elsewhere, plaintext out of Git and images – and whoever can create Pods in a namespace can read its Secrets.

misconceptions: „Secreti su šifrirani” — base64 in the API and unencrypted in etcd by default.
„Samo administratori, ili samo get, mogu čitati Secrete” — list/watch reveal contents and Pod creators can mount them.
„Secret smijem spremiti u Git” — base64 is readable by anyone with the repo, forever.
„Promjena Secreta odmah mijenja aplikaciju” — env needs a restart, a volume updates eventually, subPath never.
„ConfigMap ili Secret, svejedno je” — separate RBAC (view reads ConfigMaps, not Secrets), handling and encryption scope.
„Varijable okruženja najsigurniji su način” — env values leak into logs, dumps and child processes.
„Šifriranje u mirovanju s ključem u datoteci rješava sve” — the key sits on the control-plane host; KMS v2 keeps it elsewhere.
„Namespace je sigurnosna granica” — only together with RBAC, NetworkPolicy and Pod Security.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] Secrets are stored unencrypted in etcd by default; anyone with API or etcd access can read them; anyone who can create a Pod in a namespace can read its Secrets.
[tech-facts] base64 is not encryption; Secrets ≤1 MiB; immutable: true; types Opaque, kubernetes.io/tls, dockerconfigjson, basic-auth, ssh-auth, service-account-token.
[tech-facts] list/watch permission reveals Secret contents; the built-in view ClusterRole excludes Secrets.
[tech-facts] Volume mounts update eventually, subPath never; env vars only after container restart.

[tech-facts] Encryption providers identity (default), aescbc (not recommended), aesgcm, secretbox, kms v1 (deprecated)/v2; KMS v2 stable since 1.29 and recommended; EKS envelope-encrypts API data by default since 2025-03-05.
[tech-facts] Pod Security Admission (privileged/baseline/restricted) replaced PodSecurityPolicy, removed in 1.25.
analogies: Secret kao „ConfigMap s naljepnicom pažljivo”. Breaks down: the sticker changes handling (separate RBAC, tooling) but adds no encryption.

scenes.title: Rezervacija, ne apetit
scenes.concept: Scheduler seats by reservation (request), never by usage; allocatable = capacity − reserved − eviction threshold (example: 2 vCPU/4 GiB → 1930m/2972Mi, GKE formula, labelled).
scenes.visual: Tables with reservations vs actual eating; node bar with reserved slices.

scenes.visual: Per-node ✓/✗ table with reasons and scores.

scenes.title: Predvidite: 30 % CPU-a, a Pending
scenes.concept: Node 30 % used but 95 % requested → Pending; fragmentation: enough free CPU in total, none on a single node.
scenes.visual: Three-layer node bars: requested / used / Σlimits.

scenes.title: CPU se usporava, memorija ubija
scenes.concept: CFS quota = limit × 100 ms per 100 ms: 200m limit, 50 ms of work → ≈210 ms latency (20 ms of CPU per 100 ms period: 20 + 80 throttled + 20 + 80 throttled + 10); memory over limit → OOMKilled, exit 137 → CrashLoopBackOff (L12).
scenes.visual: Period bars; OOM burst.

scenes.title: QoS i izbacivanje
scenes.concept: Guaranteed / Burstable / BestEffort; eviction when memory.available < 100Mi; ranking usage > request first, then priority, then usage − request; kernel OOM killer if faster.
scenes.visual: Three badges; eviction order.

scenes.title: Veličine čvorova umjesto težina
scenes.concept: Payoff L04/L14: bigger nodes hold more Pods by requests; Service stays random per Pod; taints/tolerations and nodeSelector in one paragraph; in-place resize GA 1.35 changes a running Pod through its resize subresource – editing resources in a Deployment's template still rolls out new Pods; CPU limits as a trade-off.
scenes.visual: 2/4/8 GB nodes packed with Pods.

flagshipSimulation.name: Tetris raspoređivača
flagshipSimulation.description: E3 scheduler (SIM 3): three nodes with allocatable bars, eight Pod cards, manual drag then automatic scheduling with a filter/score table, usage sliders and break-it events. Zadaci: „Smjestite sve osim big-db i objasnite zašto big-db ne stane”, „Smjestite fragment bez novog čvora”, „Zaustavite OOM petlju Poda leaky”, „Učinite api Guaranteed”.
controls: Klizači requests/limits i „Stvarna potrošnja” po Podu
Gumbi za kvar: „Curenje memorije”, „CPU petlja”, „Pritisak memorije na čvoru”, „Ukloni requests”
flagshipSimulation.model: sim-models SIM 3. Nodes (each with DaemonSet 100m/200Mi): node-1 2 vCPU/4 GiB → 1930m/2972Mi; node-2 4/16 → 3920m/13622Mi; node-3 2/8 → 1930m/6249Mi. Cards (req / lim / usage): web 250m/256Mi, 500m/512Mi, 150m/200Mi; api-guaranteed 500m/512Mi = lim, 400m/400Mi; cpu-burner 250m/256Mi, CPU lim 500m, demand 1000m → throttled 50 %; batch 1000m/1Gi, mem lim 1Gi, demand 1500m; leaky 100m/128Mi, mem lim 256Mi, 100Mi +5 Mi/s → OOMKilled ~31 s then back-off; besteffort none, 200m/300Mi; big-db 4000m/8Gi → insufficient cpu on all 3 and insufficient memory on node-1 and node-3: message '0/3 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient memory, 3 Insufficient cpu. preemption: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 No preemption victims found for incoming pod.' (copy verbatim from a real 1.37 kind run when authoring); fragment 1500m/512Mi → Pending despite enough total CPU. DT 100 ms: schedule head (filter as above; score (alloc−requested)·100/alloc averaged; zero requests count 100m/200Mi for scoring only) → ContainerCreating 1–3 s → Running. CPU: e = min(demand, limit); if Σe > alloc water-fill ∝ max(request, 2m). Memory > limit → OOMKilled (137), restart, back-off. Every 10 s: Σusage > allocatable → evict one by ranking; Σusage > allocatable + 100Mi → kernel OOM kills highest usage%·1000 + oom_score_adj (Guaranteed −997, BestEffort 1000, Burstable formula). Never schedule on usage; never kill for CPU.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: „Curenje memorije” ends in OOMKilled and CrashLoopBackOff without hurting neighbours; „Ukloni requests” makes a Pod BestEffort – packed anywhere, evicted first; „CPU petlja” is throttled, never killed; big-db and fragment stay Pending with the exact FailedScheduling message.
flagshipSimulation.insight: The scheduler places Pods by reservations, the kernel punishes them by usage – two different worlds; memory is incompressible (kill), CPU compressible (throttle).

misconceptions: „Raspoređivač gleda stvarnu potrošnju” — requests only.
„Limits se rezerviraju” — nothing is reserved; the kernel enforces limits at runtime.
„Prekoračenje CPU limita ubija kontejner” — it is throttled.
„Prekoračenje memorije samo usporava” — OOMKilled, exit 137.
„Bez requests je u redu” — BestEffort: packed anywhere, evicted first, invisible to the HPA.

„Promjena resources u deployment.yaml ne restarta Podove” — changing the Pod template still rolls out new Pods; in-place resize (GA 1.35) works on a running Pod via the resize subresource (or VPA InPlaceOrRecreate), and some changes (e.g. a memory decrease with RestartContainer) still restart the container.
„CPU limit uvijek postavite” — a trade-off: limits cause throttling even on an idle node.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] In-place Pod resize GA in 1.35 (resize subresource); Deployment template changes still trigger a rollout.
[tech-facts] HPA utilisation is measured relative to requests (sets up L18).
[sim-models] Scheduler: filter/score/bind on requests; maxPods 110; eviction threshold memory.available < 100Mi; QoS oom_score_adj Guaranteed −997, BestEffort 1000.
analogies: Rezervacija u restoranu (request) i kućni red o najvećoj potrošnji (limit). Breaks down: the two limits have different consequences – memory over limit gets you thrown out, CPU over limit slows you down.

flagshipSimulation.name: Preživite ručak
flagshipSimulation.description: E3 HPA + CA (SIM 4): a compressed day against klopa-api; the timeline annotates every HPA decision with its formula; a KEDA panel scales klopa-worker by queue depth. Zadaci: „p95 < 300 ms kroz nalet uz najmanji €/h”, „Objasnite zašto HPA stane na 9, a ne 10”, „Worker na 0 noću i natrag na prvu poruku”.
controls: Segmented promet: stalni 20 / nalet 20→100 / dnevni val 10–80 / flash crowd 20→200
Gumbi za kvar: „Ukloni CPU request”, „maxReplicas = 4”, „Flash crowd uz najviše 6 čvorova”
flagshipSimulation.model: sim-models SIM 4. Sync 15 s; util = floor(100·Σusage(ready)/Σrequest(ready)); tolerance 0,1 → no change, else ceil(ratio·readyPods); unready Pods counted at 0 % when scaling up, missing metrics conservative; clamp [min,max]; stabilisation up 0 s, down 300 s (max of recs); up policy max(+100 %, +4 Pods)/15 s, down 100 %/15 s. App: request 500m/256Mi, limit 1000m, 25 ms CPU per request → 20 rps/Pod at 100 % of request, 40 at limit; target 50 % → 10 rps/Pod; min 2 max 20. Scrape = mean over 15 s. Pod start: schedule 1 s, pull 1 s cached / 6 s new node, app 10 s, readiness every 5 s. Traffic even over Ready Pods; ρ = perPod/capacityAtLimit; latency ≈ 50 ms/(1 − min(ρ,0,95)) labelled M/M/1 approximation; ρ>1 → 1 − 1/ρ dropped. Nodes 2 vCPU/8 GiB (1930m/6,1Gi), 3 app Pods each; start 2, group 2–6. CA scan 10 s; Pending → add nodes; provisioning 75 s ('stvarno: minute, ovisi o oblaku'); scale-down if max(cpu, mem request ratio) < 0,5 and Pods fit elsewhere, after 10 min unneeded and 10 min after last scale-up. KEDA: operator activates 0→1 on the first message; HPA desired = ceil(queue/10) for 1↔N; back to 0 after the cooldown with an empty queue. Validated spike at t=60: 2→3 (60), 3→7 (75, capped by +4), 7→9 (90); CA triggered t=80, node Ready t=155, all Ready ~t=180; stays 9 (util 55 %, ratio 1,10 within tolerance); load drop t=420 → back to 2 at t=720.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: „Ukloni CPU request” blinds the HPA; „maxReplicas = 4” caps capacity and drops requests; a flash crowd with max 6 nodes leaves Pods Pending; a cold image cache lengthens every new node's lead time.
flagshipSimulation.insight: Autoscaling is a thermostat with inertia: Pods in seconds, nodes in minutes, scale-down deliberately slow; you buy time with headroom, and HPA sees usage only relative to requests.

misconceptions: „HPA dodaje čvorove” — HPA adds Pods; the Cluster Autoscaler or Karpenter add nodes.
„Cluster Autoscaler reagira na visok CPU” — it reacts to Pending Pods.
„Skaliranje je trenutačno” — Pods take seconds, nodes minutes, and scale-down waits 300 s.
„HPA ne može na nulu” — beta in 1.37 with object/external metrics; KEDA has done 0↔1 for years.
„HPA na CPU-u može na nulu” — scale-to-zero needs object/external metrics.
„HPA radi bez requests” — utilisation is usage/request.
„VPA updateMode: Auto” — deprecated; use Recreate or InPlaceOrRecreate.
„PDB štiti od pada čvora” — it covers only voluntary evictions.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] HPA: desiredReplicas = ceil(current × currentMetric/desiredMetric); sync 15 s; tolerance 0,1 (per-HPA configurable, GA 1.37); scale-down stabilisation 300 s; highest of multiple metrics wins; CPU/memory relative to requests.
[tech-facts] metrics.k8s.io became v1 in 1.37; HPA scale-to-zero beta and on by default in 1.37, object/external metrics only.

[tech-facts] VPA is a separate add-on (1.8.0); modes Off, Initial, Recreate (default), InPlaceOrRecreate (GA in VPA 1.6.0), InPlace (1.7.0); Auto deprecated since 1.5; don't combine VPA and HPA on the same metric.
[tech-facts] Cluster Autoscaler scales node groups; Karpenter provisions nodes from pending Pods; KEDA (CNCF graduated, 70+ scalers) handles 0↔1 itself and drives an HPA for 1↔N.
[tech-facts] PDB covers only voluntary disruptions through the Eviction API.
analogies: Termostat s inercijom: grijanje se uključi odmah, a soba se zagrije kasnije. Breaks down: HPA works in discrete steps and depends on requests; nodes are bought, not heated.

scenes.title: Narudžbenica za disk
scenes.concept: PVC (10Gi, RWO, StorageClass) bound to a PV; StorageClass provisions on demand via a CSI driver; dynamic volumes default to reclaim Delete; WaitForFirstConsumer; PVC protection: a PVC in use stays Terminating until no Pod uses it.

scenes.title: Načini pristupa i premještanje
scenes.concept: RWO = one node (Pods on it may share), ROX, RWX, RWOP = one Pod. After a sudden node failure: NotReady → after 300 s Pods marked for eviction but stay Terminating (kubelet unreachable); a replacement Pod waits with a Multi-Attach error until the volume is force-detached after 6 min, or until someone applies the node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service taint (non-graceful node shutdown, GA 1.28), which force-deletes Pods and detaches volumes immediately.

scenes.title: Kad StatefulSet nije dovoljan

flagshipSimulation.model: Container writable layer: lost on container restart (a restarted container starts fresh from the image). emptyDir: survives container restart, deleted with the Pod. PVC-backed PV (mounted at /var/lib/postgresql for postgres:18+; fresh cloud disks contain lost+found, so PGDATA stays in a subdirectory – the 18+ default 18/docker does this): survives restart, deletion and rescheduling. Non-graceful node failure ('Čvor pao'): node NotReady → after 300 s Pods are marked for eviction but stay Terminating (kubelet unreachable). Deployment+PVC: the ReplicaSet creates a replacement at once (terminating Pods not counted), but the RWO volume is still attached to the dead node → new Pod waits in ContainerCreating (Multi-Attach error) until force detach after 6 min. StatefulSet: db-N is NOT recreated (its name and PVC are still taken) until the node returns, the Pod is force-deleted, or the node gets the taint node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service (then Pods are force-deleted and volumes detached immediately). Badge: '20 s (sim) · stvarno: 5 min + do 6 min; StatefulSet čeka potvrdu da je čvor ugašen'. Deployment replicas 3 without a volume or with emptyDir → three databases; Service picks one at random per connection → orders appear to vanish; with one shared RWO PVC → Multi-Attach on other nodes, or two Postgres processes on one directory on the same node (startup lock failure / corruption risk). StatefulSet (OrderedReady): db-N created after db-(N−1) Ready; PVC per ordinal from volumeClaimTemplates; stable DNS via headless Service; deleted db-1 returns as db-1 on the same PVC; scale-down removes highest ordinal first; PVCs retained by default; deleting the StatefulSet keeps PVCs. 'Obriši PVC': PVC protection keeps it Terminating while a Pod uses it, then PV and disk are deleted (reclaim Delete). No data replication by the StatefulSet.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: „Čvor pao” wipes the container-filesystem and emptyDir variants, delays the Deployment+PVC variant by minutes and leaves the StatefulSet waiting until someone marks the node out-of-service; replicas: 3 in a Deployment creates three databases (or clashing processes on one disk); „Obriši PVC” deletes the data for good once no Pod uses it.
flagshipSimulation.insight: Pods are ephemeral and storage has its own lifecycle; a StatefulSet gives identity – name, disk, order – and prefers 'never two db-1' over availability, so after a sudden node loss someone must confirm the node is dead; replication remains the database's job.

flagshipSimulation.name: Četiri strategije, isti bug
flagshipSimulation.description: Four lanes on identical seeded traffic – Recreate, Rolling, Blue-green, Canary – each deploying 2.0.0 with a bug affecting a share of requests; per-lane downtime, users hit, extra €, time to rollback, mixed-version window. Zadaci: „Uvedite 2.0 tako da grešku vidi < 50 korisnika” (solvable only with Gateway weights – the lesson itself), „U skrivenom načinu uočite grešku prije 10 % izloženosti”, „Promijenite shemu bez rušenja v1”.
controls: Segmented canary: po replikama / po težinama Gatewaya
Gumbi za kvar: „Preimenuj stupac u jednom koraku”, „Vrati nakon nepovratne migracije”
flagshipSimulation.model: Shared seed: 20 rps, distinct users, N 4. v2 requests fail with probability bugRate; count unique users hit. Recreate: old → 0, gap until new Ready (1 + 4 + 6 s sim) where all requests fail, then 100 % v2. Rolling: SIM 5 rules at 25/25, traffic over Ready Pods per new connection. Blue-green: 4 green Pods start beside blue; when all Ready the selector flips → new connections 100 % v2, existing keep-alive connections finish on blue until closed; rollback = flip back; double Pods during overlap (Argo Rollouts default scaleDownDelaySeconds 30). Canary by replicas: stable 4 + canary k Pods → share ≈ k/(4+k) of connections with random variance: ≈20 %, ≈33 %, 50 %, then 100 %; requested steps snap to achievable ratios and show 'traženo 5 % → stvarno ~20 %'. By weights: each request independently to v2 with p = weight/Σweights (≈5 % over many requests). Each step 30 s sim; v2 error rate > threshold → abort (weight 0 / canary scaled to 0). Expand/contract: v1 reads cijena, v2 reads cijena_s_pdv; one-step rename → v1 Pods fail until rollout ends; three steps → 0 errors; rollback after drop → v1 errors.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: Rolling spreads the bug to everyone; blue-green switches everyone at once but rolls back instantly (old connections linger on blue); canary with analysis stops near 5 % exposure with Gateway weights, near 20 % with replicas; a one-step column rename crashes v1 mid-rollout.
flagshipSimulation.insight: You can deploy without releasing; a strategy decides how many users a bug reaches and what it costs. Canary and blue-green aren't built into the Deployment object: do them by hand with two Deployments plus a Service selector or HTTPRoute weights, or automate them with Argo Rollouts or Flagger.

flagshipSimulation.name: Tvornica commitova
flagshipSimulation.description: E4: the pipeline as an assembly line – lint → testovi → izgradnja slike → skeniranje → registar (digest) → staging → e2e → [ljudska vrata] → produkcija – with a DORA panel. Zadaci: „Od commita do produkcije < 10 min uz sve provjere”, „0 loših commitova u produkciji od 20”, „Postavite kontinuiranu isporuku pa kontinuirano postavljanje”.
controls: Tipovi commita: „Ispravan”, „Pada test”, „Ranjiva bazna slika”, „Nestabilan test”, „Tajna u kodu”
Gumb za kvar „Procurio CI ključ” (trajni ključ / OIDC token)
flagshipSimulation.model: Discrete events with illustrative durations (labelled): lint 30 s, tests (pytest + web unit tests) 3 min (1 min cached), image build 4 min cold / 40 s with layer cache, scan 1 min, push 20 s, staging deploy 1 min, e2e 4 min; parallel jobs run lint and tests together. Failing test → line stops, nothing deployed; vulnerable base → scan gate blocks; flaky test fails 30 % at random → retries, trust meter drops; secret in code → secret-scan fails before push; skip tests → buggy commits reach prod, change failure rate rises. Gate: CI only stops after push; delivery waits for a click; deployment goes automatically. Digest = sha256 of the image manifest (built content); promotion carries the same digest; 'Ponovno izgradi za produkciju' produces a different digest (newer base image/dependency/timestamps) that was never tested. Tags: short SHA + semver (klopa-api:2.0.1). DORA: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, failed deployment recovery time (vrijeme oporavka od neuspjelog postavljanja). Leaked credential: long-lived key stays usable until someone revokes it; OIDC token usable only for its remaining lifetime (sim 10 min; badge 'AWS STS zadano 1 h, najmanje 15 min').
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: „Preskoči testove” ships a bug; a flaky test erodes trust; a vulnerable base image is stopped by the scan; a production rebuild is not the tested artefact; a leaked long-lived key stays usable while an OIDC token expires on its own.
flagshipSimulation.insight: CI is a habit, not a server; the artefact that was tested is the one that goes live, identified by its digest; delivery means you could release any time, deployment means you do.

misconceptions: „CI/CD je alat” — it is a practice; tools only automate it.
„CD uvijek znači automatski u produkciju” — continuous delivery keeps a human release decision; continuous deployment removes it.
„Testovi su neobavezni, CI je samo izgradnja” — without tests there is no feedback.

„CI s trajnim administratorskim ključem klastera jednako je siguran kao GitOps” — push works, but CI holds powerful long-lived cluster credentials and nothing detects drift; pull moves the credentials into the cluster and adds continuous reconciliation.
„Sliku izgradite posebno za svako okruženje” — a rebuild is a different artefact; promote one digest.
„latest je u redu” — movable and unauditable; it defaults imagePullPolicy to Always.
„Trajni ključevi u CI-ju su u redu” — prefer OIDC short-lived tokens scoped to repo/branch/environment.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] CI (Fowler): everyone merges to mainline at least daily, each integration verified by automated build and tests; continuous delivery = releasable at any time, release is a business decision; continuous deployment = every change goes to production automatically and requires continuous delivery.
[tech-facts] GitHub Actions: workflows in .github/workflows, jobs parallel by default, GitHub-hosted or self-hosted runners.
[tech-facts] GitLab CI: .gitlab-ci.yml, stages in order, jobs in a stage in parallel.

[tech-facts] Prefer OIDC short-lived tokens over long-lived cloud credentials (AWS STS session default 1 h, minimum 15 min); Docker Hub supports immutable tags; avoid :latest in production; log in from CI because of pull limits.
[tech-facts] imagePullPolicy default: Always for :latest or no tag, IfNotPresent otherwise (including digests); set at object creation.
[tech-facts] DORA's fourth key metric is now called failed deployment recovery time.
analogies: Automatska provjera pravopisa i probni ispis pri svakom spremanju (CI). Breaks down: it suggests a tool – CI is the practice of integrating small changes often.

Pokretna traka od tvornice do police, s gumbom ili bez (CD). Breaks down: nothing is copied or rebuilt between stations – the same image digest is promoted, and it can be taken back off the shelf (rollback) in seconds.

Preferred: omit spec.replicas from the Deployment in Git – but removing it from an existing manifest can drop the Deployment to 1 replica once (the default), so follow the HPA migration procedure. If it must stay: ignoreDifferences on /spec/replicas together with syncOptions RespectIgnoreDifferences=true (ignoreDifferences alone only hides the diff; the next sync still applies replicas). flagshipSimulation.description: E6: config repo (file tree + commit graph + CI bot lane) on the left, Argo CD resource tree (Application → Deployment → ReplicaSet → Pods + Service) with sync/health badges and a poll ring on the right. Zadaci: „Uvedite 2.0.1 samo commitom”, „Ručno odstupanje neka se samo vrati”, „Vratite loš commit na GitOps način”, „Zaustavite borbu Argo CD-a i HPA-a – i nakon sljedećeg commita”.

Mir s HPA-om: „ukloni replicas iz Gita” / „ignoreDifferences” / „ignoreDifferences + RespectIgnoreDifferences”
Gumbi za kvar: „Ručni kubectl scale --replicas=10”, „Netko obriše Deployment”, „Obriši datoteku iz Gita”, „Loš commit”, „replicas u Gitu + HPA”
flagshipSimulation.model: Target = manifests rendered from Git HEAD; live = cluster objects. Refresh every 120 s + uniform 0–60 s jitter (sim ÷10, badge 'stvarno: 120 s + do 60 s'); webhook → ~1 s. Sync status Synced iff every target object equals live (minus ignoreDifferences), else OutOfSync; health independent: Progressing during rollout, Healthy when available = desired, Degraded after ProgressDeadlineExceeded, Missing if absent (also Suspended, Unknown). Auto-sync (off by default) syncs only when OutOfSync after a Git change; selfHeal (off by default) also syncs live drift after 5 s; prune (off by default) deletes objects removed from Git, else flagged. Failed sync not retried on the same commit unless retry is on (exponential backoff). Bad commit → Synced but Degraded; git revert → new commit → sync → Healthy, visible in history. replicas in Git + HPA → selfHeal and HPA flap (counter). Fixes: remove replicas from Git (first sync shows a one-time drop to 1 unless the migration procedure is followed) → peace; ignoreDifferences alone → no flapping on drift, but the next commit (e.g. a new tag) syncs and resets replicas → one more fight; ignoreDifferences + RespectIgnoreDifferences=true → peace. CI bot commits the new digest; CI holds no cluster credentials.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: A manual scale shows OutOfSync and stays unless selfHeal is on; a deleted Deployment is restored by selfHeal; a file removed from Git leaves an orphan unless prune is on; a bad commit is Synced but Degraded; replicas in Git plus an HPA make them fight – and ignoreDifferences alone only hides it until the next sync.
flagshipSimulation.insight: Argo CD is the L10 loop one level up: Kubernetes reconciles the cluster to etcd, Argo CD reconciles it to Git; Git history becomes deployment history, rollback is a commit – and the config repo becomes the thing to protect.

„Argo CD reagira odmah na push” — it polls every 120 s plus up to 60 s jitter unless a webhook is set up.
„GitOps = YAML u Gitu” — it also means pulled automatically and continuously reconciled.

„ignoreDifferences rješava borbu s HPA-om” — it only affects the diff; without RespectIgnoreDifferences=true the next sync applies replicas again.
„GitOps uklanja sve ključeve iz CI-ja, pa je siguran” — whoever can merge to the config repo deploys to production; protect the repo and limit Argo CD with AppProjects.
„Rollback je klik u sučelju” — prefer git revert so Git stays the truth.
„Argo CD pokreće helm install” — it runs helm template.
„Flux je umro s Weaveworksom” — Flux is CNCF graduated and actively released.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] OpenGitOps principles: declarative; versioned and immutable; pulled automatically; continuously reconciled.

[tech-facts] Argo CD current 3.5.3 (3.5.0 released 2026-08-04), 3.6.0-rc1 out (as of 2026-10); 3.0 made annotation-based tracking the default; 3.5 AppProject .spec.sourceIntegrity configures commit-signature (GnuPG) verification.

[tech-facts] Auto-sync only when OutOfSync; prune and selfHeal off by default; selfHeal reverts after 5 s; polling 120 s + up to 60 s jitter; failed sync not retried on the same commit unless syncPolicy.retry is set.
[tech-facts] ignoreDifferences affects only diff/status; RespectIgnoreDifferences=true makes sync respect it.
[tech-facts] Health statuses: Healthy, Progressing, Degraded, Suspended, Missing, Unknown; sync waves via argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave (default 0).
[tech-facts] Argo CD runs helm template and owns the lifecycle; Argo graduated CNCF 2022-12-06; Flux is CNCF graduated and active (2.9.x) after Weaveworks shut down in Feb 2024.
analogies: Termostat čija je postavka zapisana u Gitu. Breaks down: it checks about every 3 minutes unless webhooks, it doesn't make the bricks (no image builds), and whoever can edit the setting controls the house.
lectures.bridgeToNext: Sve što opisuje Klopu sada je u Gitu – osim lozinki, koje prema šesnaestom predavanju nikad ne smiju u Git. Lana zato `secret.yaml` primjenjuje ručno sa svog laptopa, a kad se podigne novi klaster, API Podovi ne mogu ni krenuti – stoje u CreateContainerConfigError jer Secreta nema.

scenes.title: Dilema
scenes.concept: GitOps wants everything in Git; base64 is plaintext; deleting a commit doesn't clean clones → rotate.
scenes.visual: Git history with a leaked commit.

scenes.title: Sealed Secrets
scenes.concept: kubeseal encrypts with the controller's public key; SealedSecret is safe in Git; only the in-cluster controller decrypts; scopes strict/namespace/cluster. Every 30 days the controller adds a new sealing key; old keys are kept so existing SealedSecrets still decrypt – renewal re-encrypts nothing and is not secret rotation. If the private keys leak, every SealedSecret ever committed becomes readable, so rotate the real values. Back up all keys (label sealedsecrets.bitnami.com/sealed-secrets-key).
scenes.visual: Asymmetric key animation; key ring growing every 30 days.

scenes.title: Trezor i External Secrets Operator
scenes.concept: ExternalSecret reference in Git → ESO reads Vault/OpenBao/cloud secret manager → creates a Kubernetes Secret every refreshInterval; rotation path.
scenes.visual: Pipeline with a refresh ring.

scenes.title: Ostale mogućnosti
scenes.concept: One comparison diagram: SOPS encrypts values, keeps keys readable (age, cloud KMS); Flux decrypts natively, Argo CD needs a plugin (the discouraged approach). Secrets Store CSI Driver fetches at Pod start into tmpfs, optional sync to a Secret, store down → new Pods can't start. argocd-vault-plugin: Argo CD needs secret access, plaintext in its Redis cache, coupled syncs – discouraged.
scenes.visual: Comparison grid with where the plaintext lives for each option.

scenes.title: Odabir i ekosustav
scenes.concept: Decision guide (small team: Sealed Secrets; cloud org: ESO + cloud secret manager); ESO pause/resume as a bus-factor story; Vault BSL (now IBM) vs OpenBao MPL fork; OIDC in CI (L21).
scenes.visual: Decision tree with fact callouts.

flagshipSimulation.name: Put tajne (2. dio)
flagshipSimulation.description: E5 + E6: the L16 simulator across the GitOps pipeline (laptop → Git → CI → registry → Argo CD → API/etcd → node → Pod) with GitOps approaches unlocked. Zadaci: „Svi čitatelji Gita sivi”, „Rotirajte SMS ključ u < 5 min bez lozinke u Gitu”, „Ispravno reagirajte na procurjeli commit”, „Preživite nedostupan trezor”.
controls: Segmented pristup: običan Secret u Gitu / SealedSecret / SOPS / ESO + trezor / CSI driver / argocd-vault-plugin
Prekidači „Šifriranje u mirovanju” i „RBAC s najmanjim ovlastima”
Gumbi za kvar: „Spremi običan Secret u Git”, „Izgubi privatni ključ kontrolera”, „Procurio privatni ključ kontrolera”, „Trezor nedostupan”, „Token u CI logu”
flagshipSimulation.model: Extends the L16 graph. Git-history reader: reads any value ever committed as plain/base64; SealedSecret/SOPS ciphertext unreadable – unless the controller's private keys leak, then every SealedSecret ever committed turns red until the real values are rotated. Argo CD Redis reader: red iff argocd-vault-plugin (rendered plaintext cached). Ex-employee: red until rotation. CI-log reader: red iff token printed. After decryption/sync every approach yields an ordinary Secret (CSI without sync: none, but Pod creators can still mount) → Pod creators stay red (honest limit). Rotation: ESO polls every refreshInterval (sim 30 s) → Secret updated → volume consumers after kubelet sync, env after restart; Sealed Secrets: re-seal, commit, Argo CD sync (key renewal alone rotates nothing); CSI re-fetches when rotation is enabled. Store down: ESO keeps the last synced Secret (running and new Pods fine, rotation stalls); CSI → new Pods stuck ContainerCreating. Lost private key → rebuilt cluster can't decrypt SealedSecrets → no Secret → Pods stuck in CreateContainerConfigError (secretKeyRef) or ContainerCreating with FailedMount (secret volume). Deleting a leaked commit doesn't close the eye – only rotation does.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: A plain Secret stored in Git turns the Git-history eye red forever until rotation; losing the private key blocks decryption after a rebuild and Pods can't start; a leaked private key exposes every SealedSecret ever committed; with the store down ESO keeps serving while CSI blocks new Pods; argocd-vault-plugin exposes plaintext in Argo CD's cache.
flagshipSimulation.insight: Git may hold a lock (encrypted value) or an address (reference), never the key; whatever the tool, the value ends up readable to whoever can create Pods in the namespace – RBAC and rotation still matter.

codeArtifacts.title: Sigurnosna kopija ključeva kontrolera
codeArtifacts.purpose: kubectl get secret -l sealedsecrets.bitnami.com/sealed-secrets-key -o yaml (store outside the cluster)

misconceptions: „Secret u base64 u privatnom repozitoriju je u redu” — every clone, backup and CI log can decode it.
„Obrisao sam commit, riješeno” — clones keep it; rotate the secret.
„Obnova ključa Sealed Secretsa svakih 30 dana rotira tajne” — it only adds a new sealing key; old SealedSecrets and the real values stay the same.
„Zapečaćena tajna sigurna je i unutar klastera” — once unsealed it is an ordinary Secret.
„Koristite argocd-vault-plugin” — Argo CD discourages it (plaintext in the Redis cache); no release since June 2024.
„Vault je open source pod MPL-om” — BSL 1.1 since August 2023; OpenBao is the MPL fork.
„External Secrets Operator je napušten” — releases resumed in September 2025 and continue.
„Uz vanjski trezor nema Kubernetesova Secreta” — ESO creates one.
keyFacts: [tech-facts] Argo CD recommends destination-cluster secret management (Sealed Secrets, ESO, CSI driver, Vault Secrets Operator), not manifest-generation plugins: Argo CD would need secret access, rendered manifests sit in plaintext in its Redis cache, updates couple to syncs; argocd-vault-plugin last released v1.18.1 (June 2024).
[tech-facts] ESO: CNCF Sandbox; paused releases 2025-08-13, resumed with v0.20.0 (2025-09-22), v1.0.0 (2025-11-07), now v2.11.0 (2026-09-18).
[tech-facts] Sealed Secrets: SealedSecret safe in Git, scopes strict/namespace/cluster, a new sealing key added every 30 days with old keys kept (v0.40.0).
[tech-facts] SOPS encrypts values not keys (age, PGP, cloud KMS), CNCF Sandbox; Flux decrypts natively, Argo CD has no native support.
[tech-facts] Vault is BSL 1.1 since Aug 2023 (now IBM); OpenBao is the MPL-2.0 fork under OpenSSF.
[tech-facts] Secrets Store CSI Driver mounts tmpfs at Pod start, optional sync and rotation.
[tech-facts] A missing Secret: secretKeyRef → CreateContainerConfigError; secret volume → ContainerCreating with FailedMount.
analogies: Brava ili adresa: u Git smije zaključana kutija (SealedSecret) ili adresa sefa (ExternalSecret), nikad ključ. Breaks down: once unlocked in the cluster it is an ordinary Secret again, and if the lock's private key leaks, every old box opens.

flagshipSimulation.name: Incident u 12:00
flagshipSimulation.description: A seeded chaos run on the full Klopa: hidden faults, kubectl-style output, RED metrics, logs, a trace view and Argo CD status; a hypothesis is required before acting; fixes only through Git commits; score = affected users + time to recovery. Zadaci: „Riješite tri incidenta”, „Svaki popravak samo commitom”, „Za svaki kvar navedite predavanje i signal koji ga je otkrio”.
controls: Simulirana konzola: kubectl get / describe / logs / get events / get endpointslices, argocd app get
Ploča metrika po servisu (zahtjevi, greške, p95) s poveznicom na logove i tragove
flagshipSimulation.model: Deterministic fault deck, each reproducing the exact symptoms of its lecture's model: selector typo → 0 endpoints, Pods healthy (L14); liveness on DB + DB blip → mass restarts, CrashLoopBackOff (L12); readiness on DB + DB blip → all endpoints ready: false, connection errors (L12, L14); worker memory limit too low → OOMKilled 137, queue depth grows (L17, L06); tag typo in Git → ImagePullBackOff, rollout stalled, Argo CD Synced but Degraded after deadline (L13, L22); manual drift with selfHeal off → OutOfSync (L22); missing Secret key → CreateContainerConfigError (L16, L23); maxReplicas too low → HPA at max, p95 rises (L18); poison message → retries then DLQ (L06); env Secret stale after rotation → auth errors until rollout restart (L16); HPA without CPU requests → no scaling (L18); missing HTTPRoute rule → 404 (L15). Canned outputs use real kubectl formats (STATUS values, event reasons, exit codes). Fixes go through the config repo and Argo CD (webhook on); manual kubectl changes are reverted by selfHeal. Score: failed requests × distinct users; MTTR from first error to recovery.
flagshipSimulation.breakIt: „Kaos majmun” injects a random fault mid-lunch; manual fixes are reverted – every fix must go through Git.
flagshipSimulation.insight: Every layer of the course exists because of one concrete incident – and every symptom has a mechanism, a signal that reveals it and a place to look.

misconceptions: „Kubernetes koristi Docker” — dockershim was removed in 1.24; containerd/CRI-O run the same OCI images (L08, L11).
„Secreti su šifrirani” — base64 and unencrypted in etcd by default (L16).
„Service je round robin po zahtjevu” — kube-proxy picks a random ready Pod per new connection (L14).
„Koristite ingress-nginx” — retired on 2026-03-24; use Gateway API (L15).
„Argo CD reagira odmah” — it polls every 120 s plus up to 60 s jitter unless a webhook is set (L22).
„Više RAM-a = brži poslužitelj” — for an app server RAM bounds concurrency, cores bound throughput (L02, L04).
„Red ubrzava obradu” — it absorbs bursts; only more consumers add capacity (L06).
„Raspoređivač gleda stvarnu potrošnju” — it schedules by requests only (L17).

„Kafka treba ZooKeeper” — ZooKeeper was removed in Kafka 4.0; KRaft only (L06).

[pedagogy] KCNA has four domains: Fundamentals 44 %, Orchestration 28 %, Application Delivery 16 %, Architecture 12 % (from Nov 2025).
[tech-facts] Prometheus pulls (scrapes) metrics; OpenTelemetry is the CNCF standard for traces, metrics and logs instrumentation.

glossary.definition: Sustav koji ime poput klopa.example pretvara u IP adresu. Ne zna ništa o portu ni o tome radi li aplikacija.
Vrijeme od slanja zahtjeva do primitka odgovora (kašnjenje), u milisekundama. Prati se percentilima, ne samo prosjekom.
Broj zahtjeva koje sustav uspješno obradi u sekundi. Odbijeni i istekli zahtjevi ne ulaze u propusnost.
p95 od 300 ms znači da je 95 % uspješnih zahtjeva trajalo 300 ms ili kraće. Percentili pokazuju spori rep koji prosjek skriva.
Zamjena poslužitelja jačim. Jednostavno je, ali ima strop, obično traži ponovno pokretanje i ostaje jedno računalo.
Dodavanje još jednakih poslužitelja umjesto kupnje jačeg. Traži load balancer i aplikaciju bez stanja.
Dio sustava čiji kvar ruši cijeli sustav jer nema zamjenu, npr. jedini poslužitelj ili jedini load balancer.
Udio vremena u kojem sustav ispravno odgovara. 99,9 % dopušta oko 43 minute nedostupnosti u 30 dana.
Više računala povezanih mrežom koja korisniku izgledaju kao jedna aplikacija. Zove se i distribuirani sustav.
Program ili uređaj koji prima zahtjeve na jednoj adresi i raspoređuje ih na više poslužitelja. Dodaje kapacitet, ali ne ubrzava pojedini zahtjev.
Algoritam koji svaki sljedeći zahtjev šalje sljedećem poslužitelju na popisu. Ne zna da su poslužitelji različito jaki; težinska inačica to ispravlja zadanim težinama.
Algoritam koji novi zahtjev šalje poslužitelju koji trenutačno obrađuje najmanje zahtjeva. Prilagođava se opterećenju, ali poslužitelj koji odmah vraća greške može izgledati najmanje zauzet.
L4 vidi samo IP adrese i portove i raspoređuje cijele veze; L7 čita HTTP (putanju, zaglavlja) i raspoređuje pojedine zahtjeve.
Redovita provjera koju load balancer šalje poslužitelju. Kvar se otkriva tek nakon nekoliko uzastopnih neuspjeha, nikad trenutačno.
Servis koji podatke o korisniku ne čuva u svojoj memoriji, nego u bazi ili Redisu. Svaka kopija može obraditi svaki zahtjev, pa ga je lako skalirati i zamijeniti.
Posrednik koji čuva poruke dok ih potrošač ne preuzme i potvrdi. Razdvaja onoga tko šalje posao od onoga tko ga obavlja i ublažava nalete.
Jamstvo da se poruka neće izgubiti, ali se može isporučiti više puta. Zato potrošač mora biti idempotentan.

Svojstvo obrade da dvaput primljena poruka ima isti učinak kao jednom primljena, npr. narudžba s istim ID-jem upisuje se samo jednom. Lako je postići kad se oznaka obrade i učinak zapišu u istoj transakciji baze; za vanjske učinke poput SMS-a treba ključ idempotentnosti pružatelja.
Red u koji se premješta poruka koja ni nakon zadanog broja pokušaja nije obrađena, kako ne bi blokirala ostale.
Računalo koje hipervizor virtualizira (uz hardversku podršku procesora, bez emulacije), s vlastitim operacijskim sustavom i jezgrom. Izolacija je jaka, ali svaki VM troši memoriju na cijeli OS.
Dio operacijskog sustava koji upravlja procesima, memorijom i uređajima. Svi kontejneri na jednom domaćinu dijele istu jezgru; ne miješati s procesorskom jezgrom.
Izolirani proces koji dijeli jezgru domaćina, a ima vlastiti pogled na datoteke, mrežu i druge procese. Nije mali virtualni stroj.
Mehanizam jezgre koji određuje što proces vidi: procese, mrežu, datotečni sustav, ime računala. Nije isto što i Kubernetesov Namespace.
Mehanizam jezgre koji ograničava koliko procesora i memorije proces smije potrošiti. Prekoračenje memorije znači prekid procesa, a prekoračenje CPU-a usporavanje.
Pakiranje aplikacije i svih njezinih ovisnosti u sliku kontejnera, tako da se svugdje pokreće jednako. Kad se to radi Dockerom, kaže se i dockerizacija.
Nepromjenjivi predložak iz kojeg se pokreću kontejneri: datoteke aplikacije i naredba za pokretanje. Odnos slike i kontejnera sličan je odnosu klase i objekta.
Poslužitelj na kojem se čuvaju slike kontejnera, npr. Docker Hub. Pri slanju i povlačenju prenose se samo slojevi koji nedostaju.
Ime verzije slike, npr. klopa-api:1.4.0. Tag je pomična oznaka: kasnije može pokazivati na drugu sliku, osobito latest.
Kriptografski sažetak sadržaja slike (sha256:…). Ne može se promijeniti, pa točno određuje što se pokreće; ponovna izgradnja istog koda obično daje drugi digest.
Program koji stvarno pokreće kontejnere, npr. containerd ili CRI-O. Kubernetes s njim razgovara preko sučelja CRI, bez Dockera.
Prostor za podatke izvan zapisivog sloja kontejnera, pa podatci ne nestaju kad se kontejner obriše. U Kubernetesu trajnost ovisi o vrsti: emptyDir nestaje s Podom, PersistentVolume ga nadživi.
Alat koji iz jedne datoteke compose.yaml pokreće više povezanih kontejnera na jednom računalu, s mrežom u kojoj se servisi nalaze po imenu.
Opis onoga što želimo da postoji, npr. tri kopije klopa-api, a ne koraka kako do toga doći. Kubernetes ga stalno uspoređuje sa stvarnim stanjem.
Beskonačna petlja „promotri, usporedi, ispravi” koja stvarno stanje približava željenom, bez obzira na to zašto je razlika nastala.
Računalo u klasteru, najčešće virtualni stroj, na kojem se izvode Podovi. Na svakom radi agent kubelet.
Komponente koje odlučuju i pamte: API poslužitelj, etcd, raspoređivač i kontroleri. Ako stane, postojeći Podovi rade dalje, ali se ništa ne popravlja.
Jedina ulazna vrata klastera. Sve komponente i alat kubectl razgovaraju samo s njim, a samo on piše u etcd.
Raspodijeljena baza ključ–vrijednost u kojoj se čuva cijelo stanje klastera.
Komponenta koja novom Podu bira čvor prema requests i pravilima smještaja. Sama ne pokreće kontejnere.
Agent na svakom čvoru koji preko izvršnog okruženja pokreće kontejnere dodijeljenih Podova, provodi provjere zdravlja i javlja stanje.
Kubernetesov prostor za imena i ovlasti unutar klastera, npr. klopa i klopa-staging. Sam po sebi nije sigurnosna ni mrežna granica.

Faza Poda koji je prihvaćen, ali mu kontejneri još ne rade: čeka da ga raspoređivač smjesti na čvor (npr. nijedan čvor nema dovoljno nerezerviranih resursa) ili da se preuzme slika. U stupcu STATUS tada vidite Pending, ContainerCreating ili ImagePullBackOff; razlog piše u događajima Poda.
Najmanja jedinica koju Kubernetes pokreće: jedan ili više kontejnera koji dijele IP adresu i volumene. Pod se ne popravlja, nego zamjenjuje novim.
Par ključ–vrijednost na objektu, npr. app: klopa-api. Deploymenti i objekti Service pronalaze Podove po oznakama, pa jedna krivo upisana oznaka znači da se ništa ne pronađe.
Stanje kontejnera koji se stalno ruši: kubelet ga ponovno pokreće sa sve duljim razmakom, od 10 sekundi do najviše pet minuta. Faza Poda pritom je obično Running.
Pitanje „jesi li zaglavio?”. Kad ne prolazi, kubelet ponovno pokreće kontejner, pa ne smije provjeravati vanjske ovisnosti poput baze.
Pitanje „možeš li sada primati promet?”. Kad ne prolazi, Pod prestaje dobivati promet, ali se ne pokreće ponovno; ne smije pasti samo zato što je pala zajednička ovisnost poput baze.
Kontroler koji održava zadani broj jednakih Podova prema predlošku. Obično njime upravlja Deployment.
Kubernetesov objekt koji opisuje aplikaciju bez stanja: koju sliku, koliko replika i kako uvoditi nove verzije. Nije isto što i postavljanje kao radnja.
Zamjena starih Podova novima malo-pomalo, unutar granica maxSurge i maxUnavailable. Neko vrijeme obje verzije primaju promet istodobno.
Povratak na zadnju ispravnu verziju. Deployment to ne radi sam, nego naredba kubectl rollout undo, alat poput Argo Rollouts ili, u GitOpsu, git revert.
Radnja kojom nova verzija softvera počinje raditi u nekom okruženju. Nije isto što i izdanje ni objekt Deployment.
Stalno ime i virtualna IP adresa za Podove odabrane oznakama. Unutar klastera kube-proxy promet šalje samo spremnim Podovima i za svaku novu vezu nasumično bira jedan.

Popis adresa Podova koji odgovaraju selektoru Servicea, svaka s uvjetima ready, serving i terminating. kube-proxy promet šalje samo spremnima; Pod koji padne na provjeri spremnosti ostaje na popisu s ready: false.

Dodatak Kubernetesu (GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute) za ulaz prometa izvana: usmjeravanje po domeni i putanji, TLS i težine. Gateway svaki zahtjev obično šalje izravno na spreman Pod; preporučeni je nasljednik Ingressa i traži kontroler.
Stariji API za HTTP ulaz u klaster. Stabilan je i zamrznut, a popularni kontroler ingress-nginx umirovljen je u ožujku 2026.
Objekt s postavkama koje nisu tajne. Ista slika kontejnera tako dobiva drukčiju konfiguraciju u svakom okruženju.

Objekt za osjetljive podatke poput lozinki. U API-ju i YAML-u vrijednosti su samo kodirane u base64, a u bazi etcd po zadanom leže nešifrirano; štite ga RBAC, šifriranje u mirovanju i vanjski trezori.
Način zapisivanja bajtova običnim znakovima. To je kodiranje, a ne šifriranje: svatko ga dekodira jednom naredbom.
Šifriranje podataka dok leže na disku, npr. Secreta u bazi etcd. U Kubernetesu je po zadanom isključeno, osim kod nekih upravljanih klastera; najbolje je kad ključ živi u vanjskom KMS-u.
Pravila tko smije koju radnju nad kojim resursom. Pravila samo dodaju dopuštenja – zabrane ne postoje.
Količina CPU-a i memorije koju raspoređivač rezervira za kontejner. Raspoređivač gleda samo requests, nikad stvarnu potrošnju.
Najviše CPU-a i memorije koje kontejner smije potrošiti. Iznad CPU limita usporava se, a iznad memorijskog jezgra ga prekida.
Razlog prekida kontejnera koji je prešao memorijski limit pa ga je jezgra ubila (izlazni kod 137).
Kontroler koji mijenja broj replika prema metrici, npr. iskorištenosti CPU-a u odnosu na requests. Dodaje Podove, ne čvorove.
Dodaje čvorove kad Podovi ostanu u Pendingu zbog nedostatka mjesta i uklanja slabo iskorištene čvorove. Novi čvor stiže za nekoliko minuta.
Disk u klasteru čiji je životni vijek neovisan o Podu, pa podatci preživljavaju brisanje i preseljenje Poda.
Zahtjev Poda za diskom zadane veličine i načina pristupa. Klaster ga povezuje s postojećim ili automatski stvorenim trajnim volumenom.
Kontroler za aplikacije sa stanjem: svaka replika ima stalno ime, vlastiti disk i stalnu DNS adresu preko headless Servicea. Ne replicira podatke umjesto baze.
Trenutak kad korisnici dobiju novu funkcionalnost. Uz feature flagove kod se može postaviti unaprijed, a izdati kasnije bez novog postavljanja.
Nova verzija pokrene se uz staru, a promet se prebaci na nju; nove veze odmah idu na novu verziju, a postojeće tek kad se zatvore. Povratak je brz, ali treba dvostruko resursa.
Nova verzija najprije dobiva mali dio prometa; ako metrike ostanu dobre, udio raste, a inače se uvođenje prekida.
Upravitelj paketima za Kubernetes: chart je skup predložaka i vrijednosti iz kojih nastaju obični manifesti.
Praksa da svi barem jednom dnevno spajaju male promjene u glavnu granu, a svaku promjenu automatski izgrade i testiraju.
Softver je u svakom trenutku spreman za produkciju, a odluka o izdanju je poslovna, često jedan klik.
Svaka promjena koja prođe pipeline automatski završi u produkciji, bez ljudskog odobrenja. Pretpostavlja kontinuiranu isporuku.
Niz automatiziranih koraka koji se pokreće na svaki commit: provjera koda, testovi, izgradnja slike i slanje u registar.
Način rada u kojem Git repozitorij opisuje željeno stanje sustava, a agent u klasteru to stanje sam povlači i neprestano usklađuje.
GitOps alat za Kubernetes koji uspoređuje manifeste u Gitu sa stanjem u klasteru i sinkronizira razlike. Ne gradi slike i ne pokreće testove.
Razlika između stanja u klasteru i stanja u Gitu, npr. nakon ručne naredbe kubectl scale. Argo CD je prikazuje kao OutOfSync.

Alat kojim se tajna šifrira javnim ključem kontrolera u klasteru. Dobiveni SealedSecret smije u Git jer ga dešifrirati može samo taj kontroler; njegove privatne ključeve treba čuvati kao najveću tajnu.
Operator koji vrijednosti iz vanjskog trezora (Vault, OpenBao, upravitelji tajni u oblaku) periodički kopira u Kubernetesove Secrete. U Gitu je samo referenca.
Sposobnost da iz metrika, logova i tragova zaključimo što se događa unutar sustava. Metrike kažu da nešto ne valja, tragovi gdje, a logovi zašto.
